content_sections.heading: BEL Sr. Asst. Engineer (ESM) Recruitment 2026 Overview

rows.details: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL), a Navaratna Company and Government of India Enterprise under the Ministry of Defence
Senior Assistant Engineer, E-I Grade (Fixed Tenure)
Ex-Servicemen (ESM) – Junior Commissioned Officers (JWO or above rank) from the Indian Air Force only; reservation is 100% for Ex-servicemen
Offline only – by Registered Post/Speed Post/Courier; hand-delivered applications not accepted

content_sections.heading: BEL Sr. Asst. Engineer Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: 33 Electronics/E&C Stream 3 Electrical Stream 36 Total Posts Note: 1 post out of the total 36 is reserved for PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disability). Reservation is 100% for Ex-Servicemen – this recruitment is not open to civilian candidates. BEL reserves the right to change the number of posts based on actual requirement at the time of selection.

content_sections.heading: BEL Sr. Asst. Engineer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility
content_sections.text: 3-year Diploma in Electronics Engineering or equivalent, OR 3-year Diploma in Electrical Engineering or equivalent Minimum percentage/class required: Pass Class Should be a Junior Commissioned Officer of the rank of Junior Warrant Officer (JWO) or above from the Indian Air Force Must have completed 15 years of service in the Indian Air Force Discharge book/certificate from the Indian Air Force must clearly indicate medical category, date of discharge, and an Exemplary/Very Good or equivalent record The candidate's 15 years of service in the Indian Air Force itself constitutes the required post-qualification experience for this post.

content_sections.heading: BEL Sr. Asst. Engineer Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

rows.maximum_age_as_on_01_08_2026: Relaxation as per Government of India Rules in the respective category

content_sections.heading: BEL Sr. Asst. Engineer Recruitment 2026 Pay Scale
content_sections.text: In addition to Basic Pay, the remuneration package includes Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Perquisites at 35% of annual Basic Pay, reimbursement of medical expenses, Group Insurance, PF, Gratuity, PRP, etc., as per Company rules.

content_sections.heading: BEL Sr. Asst. Engineer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a Written Test , followed by an Interview only for those candidates who qualify in the written test Candidates are shortlisted for interview in the ratio of 1:7 (as per vacancy in each category) Where the number of eligible applicants is high, the number called for the written test itself may be limited in proportion to the requirement, based on academic excellence, experience, etc. Candidature is provisional at all stages and subject to satisfactory antecedent verification; an adverse antecedent report leads to cancellation Appointment of selected candidates is subject to being found medically fit in a Pre-Employment Medical Examination – no relaxation in health standards is allowed Not specified in the official notification: the written test syllabus, number of questions, marks distribution, or duration.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BEL Sr. Asst. Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application format from www.bel-india.in . Fill the application form in the prescribed format on A4 size paper, in capital letters, and paste a recent photograph on it. Attach self-attested photocopies of all required documents (see Documents Required below). Place the filled application and documents in a sealed cover, superscribing on the cover: "Application for the post of Sr. Asst. Engineer, E-I Grade/NCS SBU" . Send the sealed cover by Registered Post/Speed Post/Courier only to: Deputy General Manager (HR & Administration), Bharat Electronics Limited, Ghaziabad . Ensure the application reaches BEL on or before 16 October 2026 . Important: Applications delivered by hand will not be accepted. Only one application should be submitted per candidate; if multiple applications are received, only the latest valid (completed) one will be retained. Applications received after the last date will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Recent colour passport-size photograph SSLC mark card (as proof of age) Self-attested copies of certificates and mark sheets for all semesters/years of the Diploma Engineering (or equivalent) examination Experience certificate/appointment letter/latest salary slip from present employer (if currently employed) PAN Card copy (identity proof) Aadhaar Card copy (identity proof) Discharge book/certificate issued by the Indian Air Force, clearly indicating medical category, date of discharge, and Exemplary/Very Good or equivalent record Caste/tribe/community certificate issued by competent authority, if applicable Disability certificate (for PwBD) / caste certificate for OBC(NCL)/SC/ST in the prescribed format available on the BEL website; OBC-NCL candidates must submit a certificate issued on or after 01.08.2026 No Objection Certificate, for candidates currently employed in Government/Quasi-Government/PSU organisations (or the application must be routed through proper channel) Documentary proof of medical category, character, and probable date of discharge, for candidates still serving and yet to be discharged Failure to enclose the required documents will result in disqualification. Applications that are incomplete, not in the prescribed format, or missing the required enclosures will be summarily rejected without assigning reasons.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Only Ex-Servicemen from the Indian Air Force holding the rank of Junior Warrant Officer (JWO) or above, with 15 years of IAF service, are eligible – reservation is 100% for Ex-servicemen.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The completed application must reach BEL, Ghaziabad by post/courier on or before 16 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Can I apply online?
faq.answer: No. There is no online application portal; the form must be downloaded from bel-india.in, filled offline, and sent only by Registered Post/Speed Post/Courier.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale?
faq.answer: E-I Grade: ₹30,000–3%–₹1,20,000, plus DA, HRA, perquisites, and other benefits as per company rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the tenure of this engagement?
faq.answer: 15 years or up to age 60 (superannuation), whichever is earlier, renewable every 5 years based on performance.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: A written test, followed by an interview for candidates who qualify, shortlisted in a 1:7 ratio against the vacancies in each category.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent BEL job?
faq.answer: No, it is a fixed-tenure engagement (maximum 15 years or up to superannuation), not a regular permanent appointment.
